surface: Complete react-alien-signals 0.4.0 hook and helper surface over the reused alien-signals 3.2.1 core, including batching, manual triggers, selectors, deferred reads and phase effects.
divergences: Direct signal setters retain functional updater support; hook setters store function-valued results without invoking them twice.
The scope stop controller permanently remembers cancellation, including before commit. Upstream 0.4.0 also starts scopes after commit but does not retain pre-commit cancellation.
createEffect retains compatibility with callbacks returning incidental non-function values; only function returns own cleanup.
ssr: Supported and hydration-tested. Reads use the same server snapshot; effects and scopes begin only after client commit and stop on unmount.
notes: Reuses the inspected framework-neutral alien-signals 3.2.1 package. React and its declarations are test-only.
All 36 original upstream cases and all 90 accepted typecheck API call occurrences are retained with one-for-one native adaptations.
Phase hooks require a referentially stable signal list, matching upstream.
